verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's docs say users can manually add, edit, or delete memories under Settings > Personalization > Memory. That memory system persists facts across conversations, and the platform is self-hosted and built to run entirely offline, so the store sits on the user's own infrastructure. Nothing in the evidence says what format memories are stored in or that they can be exported or read outside the UI. The SKILL.md and AGENTS.md material covers skills in the separate Computer tool, not the chat memory store. missing for 10: documented open or exportable memory storage format, explicit statement of where memory data lives on disk, independent or hands-on corroboration of the edit/delete workflow.
